515:   /** Method for handling three-winding results. This is necessary, since a
516:     * [[PowerFlowResultEvent]] only contains partial results.
517:     *
518:     * @param transformer3wResults
519:     *   An iterable of partial results.
520:     * @param threeWindingResults
521:     *   A map: [[Transformer3wKey]] to [[AggregatedTransformer3wResult]].
522:     * @param log
523:     *   A logger for logging.
524:     * @return
525:     *   An updated map as well as a sequence of completed three-winding
526:     *   transformer results.
527:     */
528:   private def handleThreeWindingTransformers(
529:       transformer3wResults: Iterable[PartialTransformer3wResult],
530:       threeWindingResults: Map[Transformer3wKey, AggregatedTransformer3wResult],
531:   )(using log: Logger) = transformer3wResults.foldLeft(
532:     threeWindingResults,
533:     Seq.empty[Transformer3WResult],
534:   ) { case ((allPartialResults, allResults), result) =>
535:     val key = Transformer3wKey(result.input, result.time)
536:     // retrieve existing partial result or use empty one
537:     val partialResult =
538:       allPartialResults.getOrElse(
539:         key,
540:         AggregatedTransformer3wResult.EMPTY,
541:       )
542:     // add partial result
543:     partialResult.add(result).map { updatedResult =>
544:       if updatedResult.ready then {
545:         // if result is complete, we can write it out
546:         updatedResult.consolidate match {
547:           case Failure(exception) =>
548:             log.warn(
549:               "Failure when handling partial Transformer3w result",
550:               exception,
551:             )
552:             // on failure, we just continue with previous results
553:             (allPartialResults, allResults)
554:           case Success(res) =>
555:             (allPartialResults.removed(key), allResults.appended(res))
556:         }
557: 
558:       } else {
559:         // if result is not complete yet, just update it
560:         (allPartialResults + (key -> updatedResult), allResults)
561:       }
562:     } match {
563:       case Success(results) => results
564:       case Failure(exception) =>
565:         log.warn(
566:           "Failure when handling partial Transformer3w result",
567:           exception,
568:         )
569:         // on failure, we just continue with previous results
570:         (allPartialResults, allResults)
571:     }
572:   }

574:   private def updateIfChanged(
575:       resultsToUpdate: Map[UUID, ResultEntity],
576:       referenceResults: Map[UUID, ResultEntity],
577:       uuid: UUID,
578:       result: ResultEntity,
579:   ): Map[UUID, ResultEntity] =
580:     referenceResults.get(uuid) match {
581:       case Some(oldResult) if isUnchanged(result, oldResult) =>
582:         resultsToUpdate
583:       case _ =>
584:         resultsToUpdate.updated(uuid, result)
585:     }
586: 
587:   private def isUnchanged(
588:       result: ResultEntity,
589:       oldResult: ResultEntity,
590:   ): Boolean = {
591:     // Temporarily change time for comparison, then revert
592:     val oldTime = oldResult.getTime
593:     oldResult.setTime(result.getTime)
594:     val equal = oldResult == result
595:     oldResult.setTime(oldTime)
596: 
597:     equal
598:   }
599: }
